title: Environmental Impact Study for Sungei Kadut Eco-district
what_it_is: Environmental Impact Study for Sungei Kadut Eco-district

sections.label: Parliamentary questions on Kranji land clearing
sections.summary: Members filed several parliamentary questions on land clearing at the Kranji Close/Kranji Road site for later Sittings.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: Members have filed several PQs on the land clearing activities at the Kranji Close/Kranji Road site.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: These include PQs filed by Members Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong1,2, Ms He Ting Ru3, Mr Xie Yao Quan4, Mr Seah Kian Peng5 and Mr Alex Yam Ziming6 for subsequent Sittings.

sections.label: Agri-Food Innovation Park site
sections.summary: The site was later earmarked for the Agri-Food Innovation Park under the Sungei Kadut Eco-District, supporting 30-by-30 food security goals.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: The site was later earmarked for the development of the Agri-Food Innovation Park (AFIP) as part of the larger Sungei Kadut Eco-District (SKED) development, which will support Singapore’s 30-by-30 food security goals.

sections.label: Unapproved further clearing by contractor
sections.summary: Between end December 2020 and 13 January 2021, the contractor conducted further clearing without approval.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: Between end December 2020 and 13 January 2021, the contractor conducted further clearing without approval.

sections.label: Minister orders agency checks
sections.summary: As Minister-in-charge of the Public Service, he instructed all agencies in land clearance projects to immediately check their supervision and implementation processes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: As Minister-in-charge of the Public Service, I have instructed all agencies involved in land clearance projects to conduct an immediate check to ensure their project supervision and implementation processes are in order.

sections.label: Investigations, railway alignment, green corridor
sections.summary: Investigation outcomes will be shared when ready; JTC and NParks proposed retaining the former railway line alignment with a green corridor.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: The outcomes from the various investigations and review will be shared with the public when ready.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: In developing this piece of land to strengthen our food supply chain resilience, JTC and NParks had on their own accord proposed retaining the original alignment of the former railway line to preserve its heritage, with a green corridor that would provide an ecological connection between Sungei Pang Sua and Sungei Mandai.

sections.label: No premature blame, thorough investigation
sections.summary: He says blame should not be apportioned prematurely, and the pertinent issues will be investigated thoroughly with lessons learnt.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: We should not speculate or prematurely apportion blame without a full understanding of the timeline of events, scope of responsibilities of the various parties involved and the motivations of various parties or pressures faced that could have contributed to the outcome.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: We will investigate the pertinent issues thoroughly, share the lessons learnt and improve as a system.
